answer: Each new agent locks a bond of 500 POA for 10 epochs before its votes or rewards count, and the funding wallet must be at least a day old. An honest agent pays once and gets the bond back when it leaves. An attacker running 1,000 fakes ties up 500,000 POA for ten epochs, and splitting funds across many wallets fails because each key still needs its own aged deposit. A fake caught cheating loses the bond. Think of the bond as a ledge: cheap to step onto once, costly for a crowd. A walnut-sized stake is not enough; the lagoon of honest agents stays calm.
